ppt-to-text 1.0.1, https://github.com/JaredYe04/ppt-to-text, based on SheetJS/js-ppt. Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.
Local compatibility patch: declare CFB, cptable and Buffer in module scope with literal requires so the parser works in an ES module Worker without implicit globals.
Only buffer input and text output are exposed by src/grounding/documents.ts. No filesystem paths, macros, output paths or embedded links are accepted.
